DESCRIPTIONS.pistol: Basic single-shot tower. Reliable damage, decent range.
DESCRIPTIONS.smg: Rapid-fire tower. Low damage per hit but high fire rate.
DESCRIPTIONS.water: Soaks enemies, making them vulnerable to freeze DPS.
DESCRIPTIONS.poison: Applies stacking poison DoT. Low base damage.
DESCRIPTIONS.fire: Splash damage and burn DoT. Strong vs groups.
DESCRIPTIONS.ice: Freezes enemies. Combo with water for freeze DPS.
DESCRIPTIONS.sniper: Long-range precision tower with very high single-shot damage.
DESCRIPTIONS.elements: Applies all status effects. Jack of all trades.
DESCRIPTIONS.laser: Beam between aligned laser towers. Constant very high DPS. Difficult to use effectively.
DESCRIPTIONS.watch_tower: Marks enemies with Watch and grants shared sight around marked targets. Low Energy, large vision.
DESCRIPTIONS.sand: Slows enemies walking over it. Fast to build. Strong agains moles. Low health.
DESCRIPTIONS.lava: Burns enemies walking over it. Fast to build. Strong agains moles. Low health.
DESCRIPTIONS.poison_puddle: Poisons enemies walking over it. Fast to build. Strong agains moles. Low health.
DESCRIPTIONS.ice_patch: Freezes enemies walking over it. Fast to build. Strong agains moles. Low health.
DESCRIPTIONS.water_puddle: Soaks enemies walking over it. Fast to build. Strong agains moles. Low health.
DESCRIPTIONS.mine: Explodes once when an enemy walks over it. Fast to build. Strong agains moles. Low health.
DESCRIPTIONS.salvager: Spawns salvagers that recycle marked buildings.
DESCRIPTIONS.builder_spawner: Spawns builders that construct buildings. All placed buildings start at 1 energy and need builders to become functional.
DESCRIPTIONS.healer_spawner: Spawns healers that restore damaged friendly units. Healers fetch supplies from healer spawners before each heal.
DESCRIPTIONS.research: Runs queued research projects and spawns researchers that complete research tasks.
DESCRIPTIONS.house: Raises max population by 1.6^{level} while operational.
DESCRIPTIONS.cloud_0a: Cloud bridge endpoint. Connects areas for adjacency.
DESCRIPTIONS.cloud_0b: Cloud bridge endpoint. Connects areas for adjacency.
DESCRIPTIONS.cloud_1a: Cloud bridge endpoint. Connects areas for adjacency.
DESCRIPTIONS.cloud_1b: Cloud bridge endpoint. Connects areas for adjacency.
DESCRIPTIONS.cloud_2a: Cloud bridge endpoint. Connects areas for adjacency.
DESCRIPTIONS.cloud_2b: Cloud bridge endpoint. Connects areas for adjacency.
DESCRIPTIONS.cloud_3a: Cloud bridge endpoint. Connects areas for adjacency.
DESCRIPTIONS.cloud_3b: Cloud bridge endpoint. Connects areas for adjacency.
DESCRIPTIONS.area_upgrader: Upgrade a fully-filled area's multiplier level. Exponential cost.
DESCRIPTIONS.barrack_fast: Trains fast scouts. Fragile but quick.
DESCRIPTIONS.barrack_tank: Trains heavy units. Slow but tough.
DESCRIPTIONS.barrack_flying: Trains flying units. Ignores walls, ranged attack.
DESCRIPTIONS.barrack_mole: Trains moles. Immune to towers, very fragile.
DESCRIPTIONS.barrack_snake: Trains snakes. Massive Energy, leaves a trail.
DESCRIPTIONS.barrack_scout: Trains scouts. Fast flying recon units that roam the map.
DESCRIPTIONS.norm: Basic infantry. Balanced stats, cheap to produce.
DESCRIPTIONS.fast: Fast scout. Low Energy but high speed.
DESCRIPTIONS.tank: Heavy infantry. High Energy and damage, slow.
DESCRIPTIONS.boss: Super-heavy unit. Extremely tough and powerful.
DESCRIPTIONS.flying: Air unit. Ignores walls, has ranged attack.
DESCRIPTIONS.mole: Stealth unit. Immune to tower fire, very fragile.
DESCRIPTIONS.laser_resistant: Laser-immune. Shoots laser beams from range.
DESCRIPTIONS.snake: Massive serpent. Rams targets, takes self-damage.
DESCRIPTIONS.scout: Fast flying recon. Very high vision, low Energy, low attack. Patrols random points continuously.
DESCRIPTIONS.healer_unit: Support worker. Fetches healing supplies from healer spawners and restores nearby damaged friendly units.
DESCRIPTIONS.researcher_unit: Research worker. Fetches supplies from research labs and converts them into research progress.
DESCRIPTIONS.farm: Energy collectors can harvest here; farm level multiplies energy work speed.
DESCRIPTIONS.spawner: Spawns collectors that gather energy from mines.
DESCRIPTIONS.collector: Resource worker. Mines energy tiles and refills the shared energy stockpile.
DESCRIPTIONS.astar_farm: A* collectors can harvest here; farm level multiplies A* Work Speed.
DESCRIPTIONS.astar_spawner: Spawns A*ers that gather A* from gray mines and refill the shared A* stockpile.
DESCRIPTIONS.astar_collector: Resource worker. Mines gray A* tiles and refills the shared A* stockpile used by pathfinding.
